item.title: Dabo Swinney's Tuesday Press Conference Report
item.description: CLEMSON — Clemson head coach Dabo Swinney spoke to the media Tuesday at the Smart Family Media Center as the Tigers get set to visit rival South Carolina on Saturday (noon, SECN) at Williams-Brice Stadium in Columbia. Swinney was asked several questions about the rivalry. He also gave injury updates and more.
